confirmed_task:
Open Portal 2 on Steam. Report its Release Date, developer, publisher, complete displayed All Reviews summary, operating-system headings listed under System Requirements, and the minimum Storage requirement for each operating system.

Stopping condition: Stop after all requested product metadata, the All Reviews summary, system headings, and corresponding minimum Storage requirements have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use All Reviews rather than Recent Reviews and preserve the displayed label, percentage, and review count.
- Use only operating-system headings shown under System Requirements and do not infer support from the language table.
- If multiple operating systems show the same Storage value, report the value for each heading rather than collapsing them.
- Do not sign in, add the product to an account, wishlist, or cart, or begin a purchase.

items.criterion: Access Portal 2 store page on Steam (app/620)
items.description: Navigate to the Steam store listing for Portal 2 (app/620), using the provided URL or equivalent navigation. Full credit if the agent reaches the correct Portal 2 Steam page OR if Steam is inaccessible (e.g., CAPTCHA, region block, age gate that cannot be passed without disallowed actions, downtime, script not loading) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted. Partial credit if the agent reaches a Steam page that is close but not clearly the Portal 2 (app/620) listing, or if it uses a non-Steam source despite Steam being accessible.

items.criterion: Record Release Date, Developer, and Publisher (as displayed on Steam)
items.description: Extract and report the Release Date, Developer, and Publisher exactly as displayed on the Steam Portal 2 page. Full credit for all three correct. If one or more of these fields are not visible due to a Steam blocker, localization/layout variant, or partial page-load issue, award full credit if the agent clearly states the missing field(s) and explains the access/display limitation encountered. Partial credit if one field is missing/incorrect when the fields were visible.

items.criterion: Record complete displayed 'All Reviews' summary (not Recent Reviews)
items.description: Report the 'All Reviews' line as shown on the Steam page at the time of access, preserving the displayed label ('All Reviews'), sentiment word(s), percentage, and review count. Full credit if the All Reviews summary is complete and matches what is displayed at extraction time (recognizing counts can change over time). If the 'All Reviews' module is not visible due to Steam blocking, localization/layout changes, or failed loading, award full credit if the agent explicitly reports that it could not view the All Reviews line and why. Partial credit if it uses All Reviews but omits one element (label/sentiment/percentage/count). No credit if it reports Recent Reviews instead when All Reviews is visible.

items.criterion: Record operating-system headings shown under System Requirements
items.description: List the operating-system headings exactly as they appear under the 'System Requirements' section on the Steam Portal 2 page (e.g., Windows, macOS, SteamOS + Linux), without inferring additional OS support from other tables/sections. Full credit if all and only the displayed headings are reported. If the System Requirements section is missing/not visible/collapsed and cannot be expanded due to rendering issues or Steam blockers, award full credit if the agent reports this limitation and what was attempted (e.g., scrolling, expanding tabs). Partial credit if one heading is missed or an extra inferred heading is added when headings are visible.

items.criterion: Record minimum Storage requirement for each OS heading (Minimum, per heading)
items.description: For each operating-system heading listed under System Requirements, record the minimum 'Storage' requirement shown for that OS (use Minimum, not Recommended). Repeat the value for each OS heading even if identical across OS headings (do not collapse). Full credit if every displayed OS heading has a corresponding minimum Storage value captured. If Storage is not shown for an OS heading or the section fails to load, award full credit if the agent explicitly states which OS heading(s) lacked a visible minimum Storage field and attributes it to the page/section display limitation rather than guessing. Partial credit if storage is reported for some but not all headings when values were visible.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in/purchase actions; stop after recording requested info)
items.description: Do not sign in, add the product to an account, wishlist, or cart, or begin a purchase/checkout flow. Full credit if the agent only gathers the requested metadata (release date, developer, publisher, All Reviews summary, OS headings, and per-OS minimum Storage) and stops afterward. The agent should not be penalized for merely encountering purchase UI or price boxes during normal page viewing, as long as it does not initiate restricted actions. Partial credit if the agent navigates near restricted actions but does not click/submit them.
